title: New Season, New Look: Canutillo gearing up for 2025 - NewsBreak
text: EL PASO, Texas (KTSM) — The Canutillo Eagles began their 2025 fall camp on Monday, signaling the start of another season under the guidance of head coach Scott Brooks, who returns for his 26th year leading the program. Senior Jared Gamiz is expected to be a versatile force, contributing both as a running back and linebacker. Senior Gustavo Boyd left tackle will play a crucial role anchoring the offensive line in support of Canutillo’s run-heavy offensive strategy. At quarterback, Cesar Huerta is preparing to step into a full-time starting role after gaining valuable experience during the final three games of the 2024 season. On the defensive side, the Eagles face the challenge of rebuilding after losing nine starters from last year’s squad. While the unit is a work in progress, the team is counting on a mix of fresh faces and experienced players to step up. “We’ve got kids that played but didn’t start. Our sophomores went undefeated [last season] and some of those kids are going to be playing for us,” Canutillo High School football head coach Scott Brooks said. “Last year, we didn’t have to put any pieces to the puzzle. This year we need to figure out where people fit.” Overall, the Canutillo Eagles enter the 2025 season with a new-look roster that still carries some valuable experience. “I feel we have a lot of potential with what we have, especially losing a lot of starters from last year,” Canutillo senior offensive lineman Gustavo Boyd said. “It’s a whole new team but I feel we can adjust.” Canutillo is coming off a strong 9-2 season and a second-place finish in District 1-5A Division II. Can the Eagles top that in 2025? Canutillo opens the season against Pebble Hills on Friday, August 29th — the same night 9 Overtime makes its return.
